title: Dashboard plugin tiles render under the enforced shell CSP: the frame is a network-loaded, sandboxed same-origin document with its own policy instead of an srcdoc that inherits script-src

criteria.then: its iframe no longer uses srcdoc (an about:srcdoc document inherits the shell's script-src and blocks the plugin); it loads the same-origin bootstrap plugin-frame.html with sandbox="allow-scripts" only
it only runs framed and only accepts the plugin document from its parent window, sent from its own origin; it never fetches anything itself

criteria.given: GET /ui/plugin-frame.html on a running launcher (or SecurityHeadersFilter when no launcher is configured)
criteria.then: the response carries its own enforced Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts (no allow-same-origin), default-src 'none', script-src 'unsafe-inline', connect-src 'none', form-action 'none', base-uri 'none' and frame-ancestors, and no report-only shell policy
a Playwright spec mounts a records-bars plugin tile under the enforced shell policy and asserts it renders with zero enforced CSP violations
